title: Added 4 new stages and bosses to Brasshail, my Claude Code run-and-gun. Now 8 stages and 8 bosses
author: vinishkapoor
selftext:
A while back I shared Brasshail here, a pixel-art run-and-gun made with Claude Code. It now has double the content:

* **5. Frozen Pass:** boss Vulture
* **6. Dust Canyon:** boss Colossus
* **7. Jungle River:** boss Hornet
* **8. Storm Citadel:** boss Citadel

There's also a new stage select screen, so you can jump to any stage and see your best score for each.

Adding levels to an AI-built game went much faster than building the first four. The movement, enemies, weapons and boss setup were already in place, so each new stage was mostly a new background, a new layout and one new boss pattern for Claude to add on top.

The art and sounds are still CC0 packs from OpenGameArt and [itch.io](http://itch.io), all credited on the page.

[https://vinish.dev/brasshail-shooting-browser-based-game](https://vinish.dev/brasshail-shooting-browser-based-game)

Which boss should I tune next? Happy to hear if any feel too easy or unfair.
